current_internal_findings.finding: Policy Watch already explicitly models narrative-vs-revealed divergence and strategic capital rotation.
current_internal_findings.consequence: Extend/freshen the existing owner; do not build a rival policy-intelligence system.

current_internal_findings.finding: data/policy/intel.json is conceptually aligned with revealed-preference analysis but is stale at 2026-07-13.
current_internal_findings.consequence: Fresh source ingestion and point-in-time casebooks are higher priority than another theory layer.

current_internal_findings.finding: Prior audits found LLM-authored policy leans leaking into Intel Hub ranking despite a context-only contract.
current_internal_findings.consequence: Behavioral inference must not directly originate rank/gate/size; deterministic facts may be evaluated separately.

current_internal_findings.finding: Policy-Shock law forbids an administration-timing oracle and permits conditions/de-escalation plus forward evidence accrual.
current_internal_findings.consequence: Research private-intent hypotheses, but productionize observable conditions rather than an unfalsifiable timing predictor.

current_internal_findings.finding: RIC already owns policy-path repricing and rates transmission; open PRs #7923/#7940 are active and held.

stronger_candidate.definition: fresh T2 acceptance x >=2 independent evidence legs

hypotheses.claim: Restrictive U.S. financing conditions may be strategically useful or deliberately tolerated while selected strategic sectors receive protection.
alternatives: other strategic goals dominate despite unwanted rates
private investment demand and inflation lift rates
Treasury seeks lower term premium even while Fed is restrictive

hypotheses.claim: U.S. Treasury/Fed leverage materially narrows the feasible Japanese monetary/FX policy set.
alternatives: Japanese domestic inflation and wages explain timing
decisive_evidence: unexpected U.S. intervention changes OIS/JGB/FX path

hypotheses.claim: Discretionary strategic-company announcements are abnormally likely after market/issuer stress and may be cross-firm sequenced.
alternatives: own-stock support with no government coordination
decisive_evidence: cross-firm spacing abnormal under calendar null

hypotheses.claim: AI financing networks can reinforce demand/earnings and market support while increasing dependence on continued financing.
alternatives: financing is small relative to organic cash flows

hypotheses.claim: Actions+constraints predict policy outcomes better than literal rhetoric or automatic inversion.
alternatives: rhetoric is already an efficient signal
automatic contrarian read performs equally well
decisive_evidence: chronological M0 literal vs M1 inversion vs M2 actions+constraints evaluation

forward_experiments.purpose: Estimate the incremental effect of U.S. involvement on Japanese policy expectations and instrument choice.
Test whether discretionary positive strategic-company events cluster after predefined stress.
Prospectively compare T2 alone with T2 x event-quality cells.
Measure external-cash conversion and financing dependency in AI networks.
Compare literal rhetoric, automatic inversion and actions+constraints using point-in-time data.

production_boundaries: No LLM-authored intent directly enters rank, gate or size.
No raw article count is treated as independent economic evidence.
No duplicate rates, event, graph, lifecycle or learning owner.
No promotion from post-hoc T2/news discovery without prospective evidence.
Private intent may remain unresolved while observable transmission is still modeled.
